issues.description: isIncluded postcondition silently depends on mutable changedFiles state set by sibling lifecycle method
issues.detail: isIncluded was a pure function of filename + glob config; it now depends on this.changedFiles, populated later by onTestRunStart. The globCache.clear() papers over invalidation but the contract is no longer key-pure. Either include changedFiles in the cache key, pass it explicitly, or document the lifecycle invariant on the interface.

issues.description: changedFiles membership test relies on unspecified path normalization between VitestGit and isIncluded
issues.detail: isIncluded compares this.changedFiles.includes(filename) where filename is slash(cleanUrl(_filename)). VitestGit.findChangedFiles must return paths in exactly this normalized form (absolute/relative, slashed, cleaned) or the test silently returns false on Windows or with relative-vs-absolute mismatches. Normalize at the boundary in onTestRunStart and document the invariant.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook duplicated across three call sites in core.ts with invariant carried only by convention
issues.detail: coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() is invoked manually after _testRun.start(...) in three places. A fourth path will forget and silently disable changed-files filtering. Consolidate the call into _testRun.start itself, resolve changedFiles lazily in generateCoverage, or document the ordering invariant on the interface.

issues.description: changedFiles stored as array searched per-file instead of a Set
issues.detail: changedFiles is a string[] and isIncluded does .includes(filename) on the hot path, making coverage filtering O(n*m). Build a Set<string> once in onTestRunStart with normalized paths; lookup becomes O(1) and the normalization boundary is explicit in one place.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs the CLI argument grammar cannot produce
issues.detail: The transform checks value === true || value === false, but CLI parsing of <commit/branch> yields strings. The dead branches indicate either a leaky abstraction between CLI and config layers or an unclear precondition. Narrow the transform's input to string and let resolveConfig handle the boolean form.

issues.description: Inheritance of coverage.changed from test.changed is split across resolveConfig and onTestRunStart fallback
issues.detail: resolveConfig fills coverage.changed from resolved.changed only when undefined, while onTestRunStart still reads ctx.config.changed as a fallback. Two layers doing the same job, with semantics of test.changed === true (use staged/unstaged) unspecified at the findChangedFiles boundary. Pick one normalization site and define the true sentinel's contract.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is well-scoped but the implementation has unstated invariants that will rot. The core defect, flagged by all three reviewers, is the path-normalization contract between VitestGit.findChangedFiles and isIncluded: a raw string compare on shapes that may not align across platforms. isIncluded's postcondition now depends on mutable state set by a sibling lifecycle method, and the cache is no longer a pure function of its key. The onTestRunStart hook is wired through three duplicated call sites in core.ts, and changedFiles should be a Set rather than an array searched on the hot path. The CLI transform and resolveConfig inheritance both show split responsibilities that should be consolidated before this lands as long-lived API surface.
